notes: Did not run Unity/tests per instructions; existing PlayerManaPlayModeTests.cs was read but not modified (it is in the denied write path) so it does not yet cover ResetState() or ManaSpendDenied — extending it is presumably a separate validation task per VAL-001.

Spend(amount) still returns false silently (no event) when amount <= 0, since that is a caller/programming-error case rather than an insufficient-mana denial; ManaSpendDenied is only raised when amount > CurrentMana.
structured_output.summary: Added to PlayerMana.cs: a public ResetState() method (restores CurrentMana to maxMana and resets the post-cast regen-delay timer; now also called from Awake) satisfying AC-001, and a ManaSpendDenied event fired from Spend() when a cast is denied due to insufficient mana (distinct from the existing ManaSpent event) satisfying AC-002. PlayerMana continues to own only current mana and regen-delay state (AC-003) — no spell-local state was touched. Updated PlayerManaUI.cs to subscribe to ManaSpendDenied and briefly flash the fill image to a denied color, giving readable low-mana cast-denial feedback via the existing mana indicator (VAL-002/VAL-003) without requiring new scene-wired UI. No test files or other paths were modified.
